Metadata.Name: Scheduled Cleanup Workflow
Metadata.Description: A scheduled workflow that runs weekly to clean up old tasks, archive completed runs, and send a summary report.
Metadata.Author: Demo

Step.Title: Find Old Tasks
Step.Description: Query for tasks older than 90 days that are closed

Step.Title: Check Results
Step.Description: Branch based on whether old tasks were found

Step.Title: Pause Before Processing
Step.Description: Brief delay to allow other workflows to complete

Step.Title: Cleanup Summary Report
Step.Description: Generate a report of tasks that were processed
Step.Definition: {"report_type":"sql_query","title":"Cleanup Summary","sql_query":"SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC","sql_limit":50,"next_step_ids":["step-5"]}

Step.Title: Send Cleanup Report
Step.Description: Email the cleanup summary to the admin team
Step.Definition: {"to":"admin@example.com","subject":"Weekly Cleanup Report","body":"Cleanup workflow completed. Tasks processed: $input.row_count. Report data available in step output.","next_step_ids":[]}
